events.title: Bug Fixes & Rescue Cargo
events.summary: Thanks to everyone who played and left feedback! A new update for the demo is live. Fixes General bug fixes. We squashed a number of small bugs that were getting in the way of play. events.title: Next Fest Update
events.summary: Thanks to everyone who played and left feedback! Here's what changed for the Steam Next Fest demo: Fixes Fullscreen no longer gets stuck. Switching from fullscreen to windowed could leave the game shrunk inside a black screen. Fixed, and the window now fits smaller screens too. New shortcut: press F11 or Alt+Enter at any time to toggle fullscreen. Fewer interruptions while sorting. Throwing a pile into a bin no longer pops up a message every time.
